name: A New Year in Auckland 2026
information: A New Year in Auckland 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. ​ This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary. ​ Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering.
